D2.description: SemanticIndex::build printed 'Skipped N files (parse errors or unsupported)' but the chunker only labels skips as 'Binary or hidden file', 'Unknown language for extension', 'Filtered out by language', or 'Read error' - none of which are parse errors.

repro_pre.chunker_evidence: crates/tldr-core/src/semantic/chunker.rs:170-219 enumerates the actual skip reasons; none mention parse errors
repro_pre.note: CLI binary built without `semantic` feature so command isn't exposed in the default release; bug is in the gated code path.

repro_post.source_evidence: index.rs now emits: "Skipped {} files (binary, unknown language, or read errors)"

D2.fix: crates/tldr-core/src/semantic/index.rs: rephrased the eprintln to describe the real skip reasons (binary / unknown language / read errors), with a comment cross-referencing the chunker categorisation.

D5.description: tldr importers on Swift returned preprocessor-conditional lines (#if, #else) as the import_statement when the real import lived adjacent to a #if block.

false_positives.import_statement: #if false // SortedCollections is not a thing yet

repro_pre.root_cause: find_import_line() in crates/tldr-core/src/analysis/importers.rs had no Swift arm and fell through to the catch-all `_` branch that accepted any line containing the module substring.

D5.fix: crates/tldr-core/src/analysis/importers.rs: added a Swift-specific arm in find_import_line(). It (a) skips lines starting with #if/#else/#elseif/#endif, (b) strips @attribute clusters and access modifiers (public/internal/private/fileprivate), (c) requires the remaining text to start with the `import` keyword.
